application: Water metering / leak detection from a household supply meter (THIRD simulated application; flood warning was the first, outage detection the second)
data_nature: Fully SYNTHETIC traces generated by gen_trace() in this script (seeded). No field data.

generator.design_note: ch3 is the meter's continuous-flow register (minutes since flow last near zero). An earlier configuration used time-of-day; it was replaced before the headline run to restore information parity with the rule's 90-min persistence (the rule otherwise integrated history the 16-min window cannot contain). Run 1 (time-of-day) archived in run1_tod_context/ and reported in results.md. No hyperparameter tuned in either run.
generator.background: daily usage pattern: morning peak 05:30-09:30 and evening peak 17:30-23:00 (showers 7-12 L/min 5-15 min, baths 10-18 L/min 25-60 min), sporadic taps 2-6 L/min and toilet flushes 5-7 L/min, cyclic laundry/dishwasher bursts 3-6 L/min with zero-flow gaps over 45-90 min, quiet nights; flow noise sigma 0.02 L/min; pressure dips with demand, noise sigma 0.004

events.irrigation: 8-16 L/min continuous, 60-240 min, 35% of days, early morning or evening — NOT a leak (confuser)
events.tank_fill: 6-14 L/min continuous, 45-150 min, 30% of days — NOT a leak (confuser)
events.leak: 0.4-2.5 L/min sustained, 180-900 min (3-15 h), 0/1/2 per trace (p 0.40/0.40/0.20); 30% grow linearly to 1.5x rate — GROUND TRUTH

generator.ground_truth: leak state = 1 exactly on injected leak intervals; window label = state at final timestep

model.encoder: MLP 64->48->24->8 tanh (architecture unchanged from the flood/outage builds)
model.training: joint end-to-end; int8 quantisation in the loop (STE); latent noise sigma=0.03 in training; pos-weighted BCE + 0.05*MSE(recon); Adam lr 1e-3, batch 256, early stop on val F1 (patience 8, max 40 epochs) — family recipe verbatim

rule_baseline.rule: stage3-family rule_above (threshold + persistence + hysteresis + causal smoothing) on the flow channel only
rule_baseline.report_layout: event type 1 B, onset timestamp 4 B, mean flow 2 B, duration 2 B, flags/confidence + header/CRC 11 B (study's 20 B semantic-report budget)

bytes_per_day_simulated.cadence_assumption: device evaluates one causal window every 8 min (window stride at 1 sample/min) = 180 windows/day; raw and learned stream per window; rule transmits 20 B once per latch episode, episodes counted on the held-out test traces (mean per trace-day)
